definition: Stephen Wolfram (born 29 August 1959) is a British-American computer scientist, physicist, and businessman.
details: Wolfram Alpha; computational perspectives on LLMs. He works in computer algebra and theoretical physics. In 2012, he was named a fellow of the American Mathematical Society. As a businessman, Wolfram is the founder and CEO of the software company Wolfram Research, where he works as chief designer of Mathematica and the Wolfram Alpha answer engine.

explainer.lead: Stephen Wolfram is a British-American scientist (born 1959). His work spans mathematics, physics and computer science.
explainer.knownFor: Notable works include Wolfram Language, A New Kind of Science and Mathematica.
